name: Judicial Council
role: Union-wide judicial administration and oversight organ.
jurisdiction: Union-wide legal oversight: appoints judges, administers judiciary operations and warrants, arbitrates designated disputes, and receives reports from the Chief Marshal of the Union Marshals.
promotion_pass: Marshals Charter Promotion Pass — 2026-07-20; Judicator Mobile Justice Closure Pass — 2026-07-21
promotion_note: Created 2026-07-20 at STAGING per owner ruling to resolve the Marshals oversight reference; promoted to CANON by the Marshal Charter pass. 2026-07-21: Judicator Prime Field Court, Field Judge Aveline Soryn, and High Judiciary & Galactic Tribunal links registered by direct owner ruling.

items: power to suspend a Marshal operation
relationship to High Judiciary & Galactic Tribunal
design_open_questions.related_body: High Judiciary & Galactic Tribunal — superior adjudicative authority for constitutional, interstellar, appellate, war-crimes, and AI-rights matters.

charter.composition: 9 jurists, fixed staggered terms (mirrors canonical GU leadership bench, engine F6)
charter.appointment: Chancellor nominates, Union Senate confirms (engine F2/F3: executive legitimacy volatile, Senate stable across all seeds)
charter.status: administrative-judicial oversight organ; trial and appellate adjudication remains with lawfully constituted courts and the High Judiciary & Galactic Tribunal
charter.warrant_authority: duty magistrates issue Union warrants for Marshal overrides (Charter Art. I)
charter.suspension_power: 6-of-9 supermajority suspends a Marshal operation; Sentinel suspensions notify Senate

deployed_courts.name: Judicator Prime Field Court
deployed_courts.authority: Full trial-level authority within assigned Union jurisdiction
deployed_courts.administrative_relationship: Judicial Council provides appointment and administrative support; judicial decisions remain independent

composition_and_powers.appointment: Appointed by the High Chancellor, subject to Senate approval.
functions: Interprets laws and resolves disputes between planets.
Ensures adherence to the Galactic Constitution.
composition_and_powers.basis: Recovered from early-project prose claims; canon carried no composition or appointment detail for the Council.
composition_and_powers.note: The prose references a "Galactic Constitution" alongside the Galactic Union Charter. Whether these are the same instrument under two names, or distinct, is NOT established and was not inferred.
